question.prompt: What is the value of \(i(i-1)(i-2)(i-3),\) where \(i = \sqrt{-1}?\)

solutions.title: Multiply in pairs
solutions.explanation:
Grouping the factors into two pairs keeps the multiplication short. In each pair, replace \(i^2\) with \(-1\):
\[
i(i-1)=i^2-i=-1-i,
\]
and
\[
(i-2)(i-3)=i^2-5i+6=5-5i.
\]
Multiplying these results, the imaginary terms cancel:
\[
\begin{aligned}
i(i-1)(i-2)(i-3)
&=(-1-i)(5-5i)\\
&=-5+5i-5i+5i^2\\
&=-5-5\\
&=\boxed{-10}.
\end{aligned}
\]
The answer is choice \(\boxed{\text{D}}\).
